plane: local v=0 (evaluated at v=1e-10 m); x=u, vertical=z

conventions.pressure: Pa, weighted port pressure power-conjugate to the normalized motion shape

ports.sourceBasis: beta=n_air dot (+z) / coneProjectedAreaM2; inward rigid cone motion is along -z
ports.outletBasis: uniform inward normal velocity over nonplanar horn-entry star-fan interface

interface.notes: Artificial port surface joins canonical horn-cut perimeter to P. Boundary is exact; fan interior is an interface approximation, not the exact curved horn patch. Whole physical tube retained.

basisUnits: Pa per (m3/s RMS INTO the named port)
reconstruction: p = Q1_inward * basis[0] + Q2_inward * basis[1]; for an outward horn-entry flow Qentry and catalog cone flow Qcatalog, Q1=(Sm/Sd)*Qcatalog and Q2=-Qentry
qualification: Unit-flow fields require a matching qualified port matrix and solved boundary flows; pointwise field convergence is not assessed.
sourceHashNote: Hashes of delivered source; post-solve changes add metadata, checkpoints, qualification gates and basis-slice output without changing assembled equations.
